name: Email Sending (Gmail)
description: Sends an approved email through Gmail as multipart/alternative (HTML plus plain text), after re-verifying approval integrity, recipient safety and limits. Records the sent message and creates the follow-up schedule.

steps.name: Verify approval integrity
steps.description: Re-check status, approver, approvedAt and that the stored contentHash equals the hash of the current content. Any mismatch aborts the run and returns the draft to pending_approval.

onError.note: Never send on a failed verification.

steps.name: Check DRY_RUN
steps.description: If DRY_RUN is true, log the would-be send and stop without contacting Gmail. DRY_RUN is true by default in .env.example.

steps.name: Recipient and rate checks
steps.description: Confirm recipients are not suppressed, count is within maxRecipientsPerEmail, daily total within maxEmailsPerDay, and the draft has not already been sent (idempotency by draftId).

steps.name: Send via Gmail
steps.description: Send multipart/alternative with HTML and text parts, selected attachments, and the configured sender. Uses the Base44 Gmail connector, or the Gmail API with GMAIL_* variables.

onError.note: Before each retry, search Sent for the draft marker header to avoid double sends.

steps.name: Record sent email
steps.description: Create SentEmail with Gmail messageId, threadId and sentAt; set EmailDraft.status "sent" (or "send_failed" on failure).

steps.name: Update opportunity status
steps.description: For application submissions set Opportunity to submitted; for first contact set awaiting_response.

steps.name: Schedule follow-ups
steps.description: If FOLLOWUP_ENABLED and the email type warrants it, create the first FollowUp due 5 business days after sentAt (src/lib/business-days.js). Later stages are created when the previous one is actually sent.

aiInstructions.reason: Sending is deterministic. No generative step may alter an approved message.

integrations.name: Gmail
integrations.base44Mapping: Base44 Gmail connector or backend function using the Gmail API

output.description: SentEmail record (messageId, threadId, sentAt) and first FollowUp.

onUnrecoverableFailure: Set the run status to "failed" and stop; never continue past a failed safety check.
Write a WorkflowLog entry with level "error" and the failing stepId.
Send an internal alert to INTERNAL_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL (internal only; never to external recipients).
errorHandling.idempotency: Every run carries a runId. Writes use natural keys (fingerprint, draftId, followUpId) so a retried run cannot create duplicates or send twice.

specificCases.action: Abort, alert internal address that the connector needs re-authorisation; do not retry.
Check for an existing sent message, then retry up to 2 times; otherwise mark send_failed.

approval.rationale: Approval is produced in WF-06 and independently re-verified here. This workflow cannot create an approval.

logging.redaction: Never log credentials, OAuth tokens or full email bodies. Log IDs and content hashes instead.

base44.automation: Entity automation on EmailDraft status = approved; the backend function is the only code path allowed to call Gmail send.
